notes.title: What's coming next
notes.notes:
It's been a year since we released our first game. 

We would like to thank everyone who supported us and helped us improve the game by reporting bugs or suggesting features, [b]You are awesome[/b]!

Currently we are working on a new update for the game so we can improve everyone's experience.

[h3]What's coming?[/h3]

1. We are fixing bugs regarding the [b]background[/b], [b]character speed[/b] when reaching the planet stage, and [b]achievements[/b] not being rewarded to players.

2. We will be pushing the [b]controller support[/b] so you can play from your couch :D

3. General polish of the game.

This was a big learning curve for us and we are really happy with all we have achieved.

Have fun!
TurboSnail team

notes.title: The World Killer Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello space explorers!

We have something special for everyone. The World Killer Update is now LIVE!

What is new?

[list]
[*][b]The World Killer Planet[/b]

A small new threat has arrived. During gameplay, you will come across [b]The World Killer[/b]. Don't be fooled by it's size. It doesn't matter how big you are, if you collide with it, it is game over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/1612d0a9c2b56efdb6187bb82a6b15018162a5f1.png[/img]

An infinity loop to test yourself. Let's see those numbers rise!

[*][b]2 new planets[/b] into you can evolve to

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/3597014b78a2158388999b47d7629094373dcf7e.png[/img]

[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Thank you all and what's coming next!
notes.notes:
The only thing that we can say, is thank you for supporting us and getting the game! [b]You are awesome[/b]!
This was our first launch, and we are really happy about it.

We are working hard on fixing bugs and trying to make sure everyone has the best experience. We published the first bug-fix build. If you find an issue, get in touch via [url=https://discord.gg/MAcQE9bpHF]Discord[/url].

What's next for the game?

[h3]This is what's coming to the game:[/h3]

[olist]
1. We're going to be launching a new planet into the game that we call [b]The World Killer[/b].

A new threat lurks in the deepest corners of space. Alongside all the bigger objects, players need to keep an eye open for a new enemy. During the gameplay, you will come across a bomb planet. It doesn't matter how big you are; if you collide with it, it is game over.

[b]Watch out for the world killer[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/1612d0a9c2b56efdb6187bb82a6b15018162a5f1.png[/img]

There are also new planets to evolve to. Don't miss them :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/3597014b78a2158388999b47d7629094373dcf7e.png[/img]

2. [b]Endless mode[/b] is coming to the game so will be able to hunt the biggest high score possible.

Players will have the option to test their skills in an infinity loop run for the biggest high score possible.

After you finish the game the normal way, you have a new option, Endless Mode. The game will start from the beginning. You need to progress through all the stages, and when you reach the black hole stage, you will start again as an asteroid, and you can continue your journey and get the biggest score you can. 

The world around you is always different. Objects spawn in different locations and every time you have a new challenge. How far can you get?

3. New achievements!
[/olist]

Have fun!
TurboSnail team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone for playing the game so far! We're pushing our first patch to fix some issues.

[b]Asteroid size update[/b]

Some of you mentioned that the asteroid stage made it difficult for players to decide which object was smaller and which was bigger. We have updated the models for the asteroids to have a more similar shape so that the players can more clearly see which is a bigger object and which is a smaller one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/8a146ed94b8b5512288e1952e739efa59326a609.png[/img]

[b]Spawning system[/b]

We have noticed that planets can sometimes spawn too close to the player, instantly ending the game.
The system that handles object spawning has therefore been updated to spawn planets at proper distances. Now you don't need to worry about instakill.

[b]Background [/b]

Also, we made an update to the background system so that the background tiles properly as you continue to play.

Have fun!
TurboSnail team

PS. If you wish to report a bug or just chat with us, visit our official [url=https://discord.gg/MAcQE9bpHF]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Dev Log #1: Concept and Art
notes.notes:
CONCEPT

The concept for Interstellar Impact was to create a straightforward game that everybody could enjoy. You can play without devoting much time, but there will still be a challenge. 

After considering the aforementioned information, we began to consider possible creations. After considerable deliberation, we chose to pursue the idea of creating a lighthearted adventure game.  We chose to create a space game in which the player begins as an asteroid. To expand, you must collide with nearby items that are smaller than you. By doing that, you will gradually advance through several stages—from asteroid to planet to sun—until the sun explodes and transforms into a black hole.

We choose to let the gamer select their preferred playing style. The game keeps track of your time as you play, whether you're searching for something to pass the time during a break or you're aiming to beat the challenge to reach the finish line as quickly as you can. Your time will appear on the screen if you succeed in finishing the game.

----

ART

After the concept for the game was developed, we got to work on the prototypes for all the required 3D models. We required 3D representations of the planets, suns, and asteroids in order for the game to function.

We were looking for a design aesthetic to use when we first started working on the assets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/7810ea130d96ca714d594e6f0efa6940895e79f8.png[/img]
[b]ASSETS PROTOTYPE[/b]

----

We started setting up the scene and testing everything after the prototype was finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/274dc4c664badcac03303d29faadfe73c412923c.png[/img]
[b]SCENE TESTING[/b]

----

After the prototype stage, we got to work on giving the assets their final appearance. We chose to integrate geometry nodes, conventional sculpting, texture work, and VFX inside the engine to achieve the greatest results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44673555/600bca4666fe9f5cffdba70d2067ba105961d94a.png[/img]
[b]ASTEROID CREATION[/b]

----

In the end, we are pleased with how everything came out, and we are eager to inform everyone about Interstellar Impact.
